current_text.html: The whole business of the Assembly being finished, and the vote taken for final adjournment, the moderator shall say from the chair: By virtue of the authority delegated to me by the Church, I do now declare that the General Assembly of the Presbyterian Church in America is adjourned, to convene at __________ on the _________ day of __________________A. D. After which he shall pray and return thanks, and pronounce or cause to be pronounced on those present the apostolic benediction.
